title: Test & UAT Plan

owners.finalAcceptance: Founder acting as Product Owner after independent gates

independenceRule: Founder may execute and collect results but cannot independently Verify own QA/Security evidence.

performance.classification: Pilot targets; test on defined mid-range mobile and normal 4G Lao/SEA path before release

releasePolicy.deviation: named owner, reason, impact, compensating control, expiry and approvers

dataPolicy: Versioned synthetic/sanitized fixtures; no direct Production PII copy.
disclaimer: The test design is approved for implementation. QA Reviewer is VACANT — Gate blocker; no test or UAT result is Verified until evidence fields are completed and independently reviewed.
